summary: fortinet.fortios in Ansible 9.3.0 updated docs and examples to true/false booleans, updated log_fact docs and version mismatch messages, switched to version ranges, and required ansible-core 2.14.
questions: What is the minimum ansible-core for fortinet.fortios in Ansible 9.3?
Why does fortios now show version ranges in mismatch warnings?

answer_card.title: fortinet.fortios 9.3.0 changes
answer_card.answer_md: In Ansible 9.3.0, `fortinet.fortios` requires **ansible-core 2.14**, uses supported **version ranges** (smaller collection, clearer mismatch messages), and its docs/examples use `true`/`false` booleans.
